purpose: Declare one test per AC of US-19003 (FBS-221) driving rcf build bundle --next and rcf build backstop adopt through bin/rcf.js, so the FBS-221 Define round turns each declaration into a red test against the backstop.
title: Verified backstop on rcf build bundle --next: refusal on complete-unverified specs from fromBuildOrder, --allow-unverified override recorded, absent backstop inert, rcf build backstop adopt

testCases.description: rcf build bundle --next with an FBS at or above backstop fromBuildOrder at complete exits 4 with "backstop: <k> merged spec(s) complete and not verified: <ids>; run rcf build finalise <id> or pass --allow-unverified" and emits no bundle
testCases.testPointer: test/build/verified-backstop.test.js::AC-19003-1: rcf build bundle --next with an FBS at or above backstop fromBuildOrder at complete exits 4 with "backstop: <k> merged spec(s) complete and not verified: <ids>; run rcf build finalise <id> or pass --allow-unverified" and emits no bundle

testCases.description: rcf build bundle --next --allow-unverified <reason> emits the bundle, appends { reason, by, at, unverifiedFbsIds } to backstop.overrides and prints "backstop overridden: <reason>"; an empty reason exits 2
testCases.testPointer: test/build/verified-backstop.test.js::AC-19003-2: rcf build bundle --next --allow-unverified <reason> emits the bundle, appends { reason, by, at, unverifiedFbsIds } to backstop.overrides and prints "backstop overridden: <reason>"; an empty reason exits 2

testCases.description: rcf build bundle --next with no rcf/define/backstop.json, or only complete FBS below fromBuildOrder, does not refuse and emits the bundle as before
testCases.testPointer: test/build/verified-backstop.test.js::AC-19003-3: rcf build bundle --next with no rcf/define/backstop.json, or only complete FBS below fromBuildOrder, does not refuse and emits the bundle as before

testCases.description: rcf build backstop adopt --from FBS-218 exits 0 writing rcf/define/backstop.json { fromBuildOrder: 218, adoptedAt, adoptedBy }; an unknown FBS id exits 3 and a missing --from exits 2
testCases.testPointer: test/build/verified-backstop.test.js::AC-19003-4: rcf build backstop adopt --from FBS-218 exits 0 writing rcf/define/backstop.json { fromBuildOrder: 218, adoptedAt, adoptedBy }; an unknown FBS id exits 3 and a missing --from exits 2

testCases.description: rcf build bundle --next never emits a bundle while the backstop refuses unless --allow-unverified carries a non-empty reason, and the override never changes any FBS executionStatus
testCases.testPointer: test/build/verified-backstop.test.js::AC-19003-5: rcf build bundle --next never emits a bundle while the backstop refuses unless --allow-unverified carries a non-empty reason, and the override never changes any FBS executionStatus
